title: Nick Mathewson
name: Nick Mathewson
summary: American programmer who co-created Tor, co-founded The Tor Project, and served as its chief architect.
whyThisMatters: Mathewson wrote much of the Tor codebase and its protocol specifications, the engineering behind the anonymity network's security properties.
knownFor: Chief architect of The Tor Project

sections.overview:
Nick Mathewson is an American computer programmer and researcher. Before Tor, he co-designed Mixminion, a type III anonymous remailer protocol presented at the IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy in 2003.

Tor

Mathewson co-authored the 2004 Tor design paper with Roger Dingledine and Paul Syverson and became the project's chief architect, writing large parts of the Tor daemon and its protocol specifications. He co-founded The Tor Project as a non-profit in 2006.

Other work

He is the primary author of Libevent, an event-notification library used by Tor and many other network programs, and co-authored the Pynchon Gate private information retrieval design with Len Sassaman and Bram Cohen.

timeline.event: Co-presents the Mixminion type III remailer design at IEEE S&P.
